hint: Compare the coordinates of the two points. One of them is the same in both, which tells you the direction of the segment.

hints.text: Compare the coordinates of the two points. One of them is the same in both, which tells you the direction of the segment.
Both points have $y = 1$, so the segment is horizontal and the distance is the gap between $x = -4$ and $x = 6$. Set up $|6 - (-4)|$.

explanation: Both points have the same $y$-coordinate, $1$, so they lie on a horizontal line.
On a horizontal line the distance is the absolute value of the difference of the $x$-values: $|6 - (-4)|$.
Subtracting $-4$ is the same as adding $4$, so the difference is $6 + 4 = 10$.
The distance between $(-4, 1)$ and $(6, 1)$ is $10$ units.
